visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a close-up shot of a textured wooden table scattered with various retro toys and board games. A traditional Go board with black and white stones sits prominently next to a wooden marble-rolling mechanism. Piles of colorful fabric in red, yellow, and blue are bunched up in the foreground. (2) A young boy wearing a striped shirt and a young girl in a pink sweater are seen playing with a wooden pinball-style game. They use their small hands to manipulate the wooden paddles and knobs. An adult woman’s hand occasionally enters the frame to guide their play. The background is a large, brightly lit indoor hall. (3) A wide-angle perspective reveals a spacious indoor room where several people are seated at long wooden tables, engaged in various games. The walls are white and adorned with numerous small photographs and decorative banners. Natural light enters from windows on the far side, creating a bright and airy atmosphere. (4) A glass display case is shown, filled to capacity with nostalgic household items and toys from past decades. Items include old-fashioned glass bottles, baby feeding sets, and assorted small figurines. Each object is carefully placed on the glass shelving, highlighting its historical and collectible nature in a museum-like setting. (5) The camera captures the children from a high-angle view as they interact with a large, green-topped wooden table game. They lean over the table, focused on moving wooden pieces across the surface. The boy’s striped shirt and the girl’s pink top contrast against the warm, natural wood of the environment. (6) A young girl sits on a large, red and blue wooden rocking toy shaped like a vintage scooter. She is laughing with her mouth wide open, expressing pure joy. A man’s arm is visible beside her, providing stability. In the background, shelves are packed with robot figures and colorful boxed toys. (7) A series of quick cuts shows the children using miniature exercise equipment, including a small treadmill with a yellow smiley face and a yellow stationary bike. The lighting remains bright and consistent throughout. The background continues to feature high shelves filled with an extensive collection of figurines and toy boxes. (8) The boy and girl are seen seated at a small wooden table playing a game of Go. They carefully place white and black stones onto the grid. The adult male, wearing a mask and glasses, sits nearby, watching them. The final shots show the family exploring a room filled with wooden rocking horses.
